descriptions.files_delete_stop: Stop a running background delete task before it finishes. Required: taskid (from files_delete_start). Returns no body on success; use files_delete_stop only to abort, not to check progress - poll files_delete_status for that.
descriptions.files_info: Report File Station's server-side capabilities and limits: supported protocols, max upload size, and enabled features. No parameters. Call this once before scripting file operations to confirm a feature (like search or thumbnails) is actually available on this NAS.
descriptions.folder_list: List every shared folder on the NAS with name, path, and space usage. Optional: additional (extra fields like nfs_privilege or encryption), limit, offset for pagination. Use folder_list to discover folder names, then folder_get for one folder's full detail or folder_permissions for its ACL.
descriptions.group_list: List local DSM user groups with name and description. Optional: additional (extra fields), limit, offset for pagination. Use group_list to find a group name, then group_members to see which accounts belong to it.
descriptions.session_logout: Invalidate the current DSM session id, ending the authenticated session immediately. No parameters, no response body. Call this to explicitly end a session rather than letting it expire; a new session_login is required afterward for further calls.
descriptions.storage_esata: List eSATA storage devices physically attached to the NAS, with device name and status. Optional: additional (extra fields). Returns an empty list on units with no eSATA port or nothing plugged in.
descriptions.storage_luns: List iSCSI LUNs (block-storage targets) configured on this NAS, with name, size, and backing volume. No parameters. Returns an empty list on units with iSCSI Manager not configured.
descriptions.storage_smart_schedule: List the configured SMART self-test schedule (test type and recurrence) applied to the NAS's physical disks. No parameters. Use storage_smart for a specific disk's actual SMART attribute results.
descriptions.storage_usb: List USB storage devices physically attached to the NAS, with device name and status. Optional: additional (extra fields like dev_type or status). Returns an empty list on units with nothing plugged into a USB port.
